prerequisites: Medically fit for work at height, supported by a doctor’s statement
No history of vertigo, epilepsy, or uncontrolled cardiac conditions
No prior rope access experience required
Final administrative requirements follow current Kemnaker rules — we check them with you on enrolment
outcomes: Understand the legal basis for work-at-height safety (Ministry of Manpower Regulation 9/2016)
Wear, inspect, and log the condition of PPE and rope access equipment
Ascend, descend, and change position on a two-rope system — working line and safety line
Work safely under the supervision of a TKPK Level 2 or 3 technician
Carry out a straightforward colleague rescue and first aid

sections.body:
## Who this programme is for

This programme is for people starting out on rope access — building technicians, façade crews, tower technicians, welders, or inspectors — who need to reach areas scaffolding or a gondola cannot.

## Why a Kemnaker certificate

[Ministry of Manpower Regulation 9/2016](https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/1210/peraturan-menteri-ketenagakerjaan-nomor-9-tahun-2016) requires work at height to be carried out by competent workers. The certificate and K3 licence issued by Indonesia’s Ministry of Manpower (Kemnaker RI) are nationally recognised proof of competence, checked by labour inspectors, contractors, and building managers alike. Read more about the [TKPK and TKBT schemes](/en/certification/).

## How we teach

Theory and practice run side by side: every topic is practised at height under instructor supervision and repeated until it is right. Training equipment is provided; trainees only need safety boots and work clothing.

## After you qualify

Once you have built up enough working experience, the next step is [TKPK Level 2](/en/tkpk-level-2-training/).

items.q: How much does TKPK Level 1 training cost?
items.a: The cost of TKPK Level 1 depends on the number of participants, the location (open course or in-house), and your company’s needs. Send us your requirements on WhatsApp and we reply with a written quotation listing everything included.

items.q: How long is TKPK Level 1 training?
items.a: TKPK Level 1 duration and dates are confirmed on enrolment, following the syllabus and current Kemnaker competency test rules. Company courses can be scheduled on dates you choose.

items.q: What is tested for TKPK Level 1?
items.a: The competency test covers theory and practice: work-at-height regulation, equipment inspection, technique for the grade, and rescue. Successful candidates receive a competency certificate and K3 licence from Kemnaker RI.

items.q: How is TKPK Level 1 different from TKBT Level 1?
items.a: TKPK Level 1 covers work hanging on rope (rope access), while TKBT Level 1 covers climbing structures with fall arrest. Choose by how you work on site; many technicians take both.

sections.title: Enrol or ask about the next course
sections.text: Send your name, the number of participants, and the month you are aiming for. For a group from one company, the course can run at your site.
